pl-l4d24c16-d1e112.summary: States that the pontiff is the chief of priests, a way for those following; he is called high priest, since he makes priests and Levites and arranges all ecclesiastical orders.
claims: The bishop ordains priests and deacons and orders the Church.

pl-l4d24c16.summary: The pontiff is chief of priests, a way for those who follow, also called high priest: he makes priests and Levites and arranges all ecclesiastical orders.
claims: The pontiff is chief of priests and ordains all others.
